providers.note: business_low_volume is a Low-Volume Standard brand (skip_automatic_sec_vet, no secondary vetting) with a LOW_VOLUME campaign, from Twilio docs; not yet checked against a Twilio invoice. One Twilio page gives the brand as $4; brand_usd uses $4.50, the same as person.brand_usd. No faster_lane_usd: Twilio's API cannot add vetting to a Low-Volume Standard brand, so Hail never asks for it.

Brand $4.50, campaign review $15, campaign $2/month (sole proprietor) or $10/month (mixed), from source_url. Campaign fees are billed for three months initially. business.brand_usd is the $4.50 brand plus about $41 Aegis standard vetting, which source_url does not list; the vetting price is from https://api.support.vonage.com/hc/en-us/articles/360058158511-10-DLC-Pricing-and-Fees ($41.50) and https://www.telgorithm.com/news/how-much-does-10dlc-registration-cost-2025-guide-for-isvs. Not yet checked against a Telnyx invoice. business_low_volume is the $4.50 brand with no externalVetting call and a LOW_VOLUME campaign at $1.50/month, from source_url. The Telnyx API reference gives the low volume campaign as $6 up front (first 3 months), then $2/month; not yet checked against a Telnyx invoice. business_low_volume.faster_lane_usd is the STANDARD externalVetting Hail asks for when a low-volume brand comes back UNVERIFIED and the customer allowed it ($41.50, from https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/messaging/10dlc/brand-registration).
